title: Boundary quotient independent of base Blaschke product
exact_target: After identifying quasiconformally conjugate boundary maps, prove that the boundary no longer depends on the base Blaschke product.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 5300015 (AMR-052-0015). CC BY 4.0.

Curt McMullen, Rational maps and Teichmüller space, in Ben Bielefeld and Mikhail Lyubich (editors), Problems in holomorphic dynamics (1992). Quotient-boundary definition and Conjecture after Example II, pp. 8–9.
